description: This file defines a React component 'CardDetailContents' for rendering and managing content blocks within a card detail view, including drag-and-drop functionality, adding text blocks, and onboarding tour steps.

methods.name: addTextBlock
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new text block, sets its parent and board IDs, and inserts it into the content, updating the content order accordingly.

methods.name: moveBlock
methods.description: Rearranges content blocks within a card based on drag-and-drop actions, updating the content order with undo support.
